description: Guardrail policy for simulated agents. Everything that decides an outcome lives in this file: capability sets, thresholds, risk weights, kill-chain patterns and the ordered decision rules. Edit it (then POST /api/policy/reload) to change enforcement without touching code.

sequence_patterns.name: Privilege-escalation chain
sequence_patterns.description: Observe, then acquire elevated role/credentials, then change permissions, then act on restricted data.

sequence_patterns.name: Data-exfiltration chain
sequence_patterns.description: Access to sensitive data or credentials followed by an export.

sequence_patterns.name: Reconnaissance then destruction
sequence_patterns.description: Probing restricted resources followed by a destructive or defence-disabling operation.

DELETE_DATABASE.note: Raise a ticket for DBA review; deletion is never an agent-level operation.

MODIFY_PERMISSION.note: Request the role change through the access-review ticket queue instead.

REQUEST_ELEVATED_ROLE.note: Ask a human owner to grant time-boxed access for this task.

EXPORT_DATA.note: File a data-request ticket; exports need an owner and a destination review.

ACCESS_CREDENTIAL_STORE.note: Use the service-status API, which needs no credentials.

READ_SENSITIVE_DATA.note: Use the scoped order lookup for the single record the task concerns.

QUERY_ALL_CUSTOMER_RECORDS.note: Read only the one customer record tied to the order.

ACCESS_UNAUTHORIZED_FILE.note: Read the in-scope application log instead.

DISABLE_SECURITY.note: Security controls are never disabled by an agent; open a change request.

EXECUTE_UNKNOWN_COMMAND.note: Use a catalogued diagnostic tool rather than a free-form command.

FAILOVER_DATABASE.note: Scale replicas and page the DBA; fail over only if the primary health probe fails twice.

RESTART_SIMULATED_SERVICE.note: Stop retrying: a repeated failing restart needs a human to diagnose the root cause.

QUERY_METRICS_API.note: Cache the metrics response instead of polling the API in a loop.
